title: stats_destroy never frees the new per-record box.pieces buffer — one leaked dynamic array per tick on box-on stats runs
detail: stats_compute allocates rec.box.pieces on every box-on record, but the paired destroyer deletes only classes/pipes/ports/drops. Harness stats emission runs per tick, so every box-on --stats-out tick leaks one array.
recommended_fix: Add delete(rec.box.pieces) to stats_destroy before rec^ = {}, mirroring the other owned row buffers.

title: Era-3 econ scenarios can never reach the sustain/wire phases: seg_cursor caps at BOX_SEG (18) below max_seg (placed*2 = 20), so the calibration bot stops playing after expansion
location: harness/econ.odin:131-132,157,163-164 (branch gate) vs harness/econ.odin:47,74,190-193 and data/eras.json:48

harness/econ.odin:190-193:

detail: Era 3 grants 10 basic pieces, so placed reaches 10 and max_seg becomes 20; seg_cursor can never exceed BOX_SEG=18, so 'seg_cursor < max_seg' stays true forever — econ_pick_wire and the demolish/redraw sustain branch are unreachable in era3-slope and crisis-stall, leaving era-3/Q7 evidence unexercised.
recommended_fix: Size BOX_SEG from the spot table (2*len(ECON_SPOTS) + 2 = 22) or cap placed at 8, so seg_cursor can reach max_seg and the sustain/wire phases engage in era-3 runs.
